title: Normal CLI play never passes the adventure-module resolver to runTurn
description:
Verified at main f4b3461. packages/cli/src/playTypes.ts:35 PlayDeps declares no resolveAdventureModule; packages/cli/src/playTurnLoop.ts:96-107 builds RunTurnDeps without one. Consequently contextAssembler.assembleAdventureContext returns [] (an active adventure run contributes no context to the DM turn) and encounterCombatants.ts:638-642 throws 'start_encounter requires an active adventure module resolver' for an authored encounterId. packages/cli/src/adventures.ts:101 makeModuleResolver exists but its real consumer is the read-only 'adventures show' path.

Existing CLI tests use a fake runTurn and core tests inject a resolver, so neither exercises the real handoff.

Discovered by eshyra-jued (2026-07-29-existing-discovery-substrate-map.md defect 2). Blocker B2 of 2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md: adventure-context discovery evidence (probe P9) is invalid until this is repaired.
acceptance_criteria: Normal CLI play supplies resolveAdventureModule to runTurn; an active adventure run contributes its context slice on a real turn; start_encounter by authored encounterId succeeds; a test exercises the real selected-module-to-runTurn handoff rather than a fake runTurn.
notes:
2026-08-30: Began implementation in worktree eshyra-seoh. Added PlayDeps.resolveAdventureModule, forwarded it in playTurnLoop, and production resolver wiring from the selector's merged bundled/installed inventory. Added a real-runTurn regression test that selects the bundled module and asserts its DM-only context appears in the model turn context. npm run typecheck and npm run check pass. Focused play.test.ts is currently blocked before test execution by pre-existing RulesPackError: records[841].data.mechanics has unsupported key "ambiguities" from origin/main.
2026-08-30 correction: The reported RulesPackError was NOT present on main. The seoh worktree initially inherited the parent checkout's stale compiled @eshyra/core via its ancestor node_modules, creating an old-validator/new-rules-pack mismatch. Evidence: CI succeeded on c6cf3a5 and current main 6015db0; after npm ci created worktree-local workspace links, npm run typecheck and focused play.test.ts passed (45 passed, 1 skipped).
2026-08-30: Rebased onto origin/main 6015db0. Verification passed after worktree-local npm ci: npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm run test (263 files passed, 4 skipped; 4732 tests passed, 19 skipped). Regression now also starts authored enc-mouth-ambush through real runTurn and asserts two combatants.
close_reason: CLI now supplies the selected adventure-module resolver to real turns; regression covers context and authored encounter lookup.
